The hosted data manager below runs the same app as
`bayesmaDatR::launch_data_entry()`. Uploaded files are processed in your
session only; run the app locally for confidential data.

```{=html}
<iframe id="bayesmadatr-app"
        src="https://REPLACE-WITH-APP-ID.share.connect.posit.cloud/"
        style="width: 100%; min-height: 900px; border: none; display: block;"
        scrolling="no">
</iframe>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@iframe-resizer/parent@5"></script>
<script>
  iframeResize({ license: "GPLv3", waitForLoad: true }, "#bayesmadatr-app");
</script>
```
